text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Briza Valley - Alces Atelier and Twilight Caravan are confronted by a deer girl who resembles Louise Marie.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブリザ渓谷──
【アルケス錬金堂】と【トワイライトキャラバン】は、
ルイズマリーに似た鹿の少女と対峙する。

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: Wha-... Wh-Wh-What...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
な……
ななな……

text_block_list.name: ルイズマリー
text_block_list.text:
はあ……
ついに見つけたわ……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
ついに見つけたわ……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: You say finally, but we didn't make any effort at all to find her. As soon as we left town, here she is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ついに
ってほど
苦労してないけどな。
出発後、
ほぼ直だし。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Uwaaah! Look, look! Amazing, it's like there's two Rui-chans, it's so funny! Iroha too! Iroha wants another Iroha, too!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ！　
見て見て！
すごい、
ルイちゃんが二人いるみたいでおもしろ～い！
イロハも、
もう一人イロハほしい～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right! Hey, Rui-chan, come here, line up! Okay, let's gooo...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ
そうだ！
ねー
ルイちゃん
こっちきて、
並んで！
はい、
いくよ～！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Astral projection...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゆ～
たいりだつ～～～っ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie & Maristella
text_block_list.text: What are you trying to make us do?!
text_block_list.orig_name: ルイズマリー・マリステラ
text_block_list.orig_text: 何やらせてんのよ！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Grandmother!! You're... grandmother Maristella, aren't you!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おばあさま！！
あなた、
マリステラおばあさまでしょ！？

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: H-How do you know my name?! Wait... More importantly, who's the "grandma"?! So rude to call such a trendy, young gal that!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんで私の名前を！？
って……
そんなことより、
誰がおばあさまよっ！！
こんなピッチピチのナウいギャル捕まえて
失礼しちゃうわ！！

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: Besides, who are YOU?! Are you trying to impersonate me?! Get lost, you imitation of me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それよりあんたは何者なの！？
私のモノマネのつもりかしら！？
消え失せなさい、
この
イミテイション・私！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Who's the imitation?! It's me, Louise Marie! I'm your granddaughter, a genius alchemist who surpassed even you, Grandma Maristella!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰がイミテイションよ！　
私よ、
ルイズマリーよ！
マリステラおばあさまを超える天才錬金術師の
あなたの孫よ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Such a casual boast...
text_block_list.orig_text: さり気にマウント……

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: My granddaughter?! How dare you joke about me having a grandchild when I've never even had a relationship before, you silly prankster!! I mean, not that I’m unpopular or anything! I could totally snag a partner and settle down forever if I felt like it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
孫！？　
男女交際もしたことない私が
孫とか
冗談はよし子ちゃん！
ま、
モテるし！？　
アベック成立して
永久就職だって
余裕のよっちゃんだけど！

text_block_list.name: Homun-Homun
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Where does that leave me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
俺とかどうだろ？

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: First of all... to say there could ever be a genius alchemist that can surpass me?! Don't be ridiculous! I really want to see the faces of your parents!
text_block_list.orig_text:
第一
私を超える天才錬金術師なんているかっての！
ふざけたこと言うんじゃないわ！
まったく
親の顔が見てみたいってもんよ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: One of my parents is your daughter, but... No, more importantly... What do you mean you don't know me...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の親はあなたの娘ですけど……
い、
いやそれよりも。
私を知らないって
どういうこと……！？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Putting aside that giant who's been gracefully ignored... Hey, Lou-taso, can we safely say that really is your grandma? Final answer? Like, no fake or anything like that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
華麗にスルーされた巨人は置いといて……
ねえルイたそ、
あれって
確実にあなたのおばあさま
ってことで
FA？
偽物とかじゃなく？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I suppose we should check and make sure first... Hey, grandmother! Open that gold pendant you're wearing. There should be a picture inside. Do you recognize it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずはそれを確かめた方が良さそうね……
ね
え、
おばあさま！
あなたが付けてる金のペンダント、
ちょっと開けてみて。
中に写真があるはずよ。
見覚えはないかしら？

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: Quit calling me your grandma or I'll twist you into a pretzel! ...Geez, what's with this pendant? Now that I think about it, when did I even get this thing... this golden pendant?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その
おばあさまってやめなさい
捻るわよ！！
……ったく
このペンダントがなに？
そういやいつの間にか持ってたのよね、
この金のペンダント。

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: A picture... Wait, there's a photo of some unknown old lady and a child in it!? That's so creepy...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
写真……
って、
中になんかしらないばあさんと子どもの写真が！？
不気味だわ……！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Nothing of the sort! That's me and you in there!
text_block_list.orig_text: いやそれあなたと私だから！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Maristella. Do you remember me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……マリステラ。
私のことは覚えているかしら？

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: Hmph! I don't remember every single woman's face! I don't want anyone other than a modern, young and handsome boy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんっ！　
女の顔なんかいちいち覚えてないわ！
ナウでヤングなハンサムボーイ以外
お呼びじゃないの！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Don't play dumb on me, okay? I won't let you say you don't remember.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……しらばっくれるんじゃないわよ？
覚えてないとは言わせない。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Ten years ago, on the night of a certain storm, a newbie doctor... Does that ring a bell?
text_block_list.orig_text:
10年前、
嵐の夜の新米ドクター
……と言えば分かるかしら？

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: I told you, I don't know anything about that! Ten years ago I'd have been seven!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから知らないってば！
10年前って私７歳だし。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? It doesn't seem like you're pretending not to know. Could it be that you've lost your memory...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……？
知らないふりって訳じゃなさそうね。
まさか、
記憶を失っている……？

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: ...Louise Marie. Does that "Forbidden Rejuvenation Elixir" just rejuvenate one's body? For example, is there a possibility that it could cause memory loss as a side effect?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ルイズマリー
例の『若返りの秘薬』
ってのは、
肉体が若返るだけなのか？
例えば
記憶障害が起こる
副作用の可能性は？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Only the body will become younger, knowledge and memories should remain the same. I can't really say for sure about side effects, though... but if its my genius grandmother we're talking about, she'd never make such a mistake!
text_block_list.orig_text:
若返るのは肉体だけで
知識や記憶はそのままのはずよ。
副作用については
何とも言えないけど……
天才のおばあさまにそんな失敗は、
まずあり得ない。

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: ...I've just had it with you!! I'm going to make you go home by force! You're up, Homun-Homun!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……もういい加減あったまきた！！　
力ずくで帰ってもらうわ！
出番よ
ホムンホムン！！

text_block_list.name: Homun-Homun
text_block_list.text: Alright, leave it to me, Maristella!!! I love you!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っしゃあ、
任せろマリステラ、
好きだ！！

text_block_list.name: Homun-Homun
text_block_list.text: Ooooooooh...!!
text_block_list.orig_text: オオオオオ……ッ！！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: EEEK!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ひいっ！？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That's one hell of a pressure that thing's emitting...! Everyone, be on guard!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とんでもない圧だね……！
みんな
警戒を！

text_block_list.name: Homun-Homun
text_block_list.text: My name is Homun-Homun!! I am a homunculus created by Maristella's alchemy!! I'm going to go full throttle today too!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おれの名前はホムンホムン！！
マリステラの錬金術によって生み出された錬成生物だ！！
今日もバリバリ全開で
つっぱってくぜ！！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Homun-Homun. ...Pfft. Kus kus.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホムンホムン。
……ぷっ。
クスクス。

text_block_list.name: Homun-Homun
text_block_list.text: D-Don’t laugh! That’s the name that Maristella personally gave me after thinking it over for three days and three nights!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
笑うなーっ！
マリステラが三日三晩考え抜いてつけてくれた名前だぞ！

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: Sorry. I actually just thought about it for two seconds.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめん。
二秒で付けた。

text_block_list.name: Homun-Homun
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry I was born...
text_block_list.orig_text: 生まれてきてすみません……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: How negative...
text_block_list.orig_text: ネガティブだな。

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: Come on, Homun-Homun!! Send these fellows packing!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあホムンホムン！！
こいつら追い返してちょうだい！！

text_block_list.name: Homun-Homun
text_block_list.text: Understood, loud and clear!! Well then, excuse me for being a little rough!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
合点承知の介ェ！！
じゃあ、
少々手荒にいかせてもらうとするか！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: That goes for you too, Uncle! TEIYAAAAAH!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おじちゃんもね！
てやあっ！！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: ...Hm! She blocked that giant's fist with just her sheath...! Haha, not bad!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！
あの巨人の拳を鞘で……！
はは、
やるねえ！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! I've been wondering about it for a while now. Let's have a contest to see who's stronger, you or Iroha!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ！
さっきからずーっと気になってたんだ。
イロハとどっちが強いか
勝負しよ！？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Well then, here I come... Homu-chan!! HAAAAAAAAH!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあいくよ、
ホムちゃん！！
はああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Homun-Homun
text_block_list.text: Who are you calling Homu-chan?!! WHOAAAAAAAAA!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰がホムちゃんだぁっ！！
ウオオーッ！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, gran-... Maristella-san. I hear you've caused disasters in many places and made monsters go on a rampage.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねえおばあ……
マリステラさん。
あなた
色々な場所で災害を起こしたり、
魔物を暴れさせたりしているそうね。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...You were such a kind person, so why would you do something like that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……優しかったあなたが、
なんでそんなことを？

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: Hmph, isn't it obvious? To show the world my powers as an alchemist! And most importantly, because it makes me feel refreshed!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんっ、
そんなの決まってるでしょ？
私の錬金術師としての力を
世に知らしめてやるためよ！
それになにより、
スカッとするしね！

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: She's completely different from the image of her you pictured... In what world would this girl grow a kind personality? She's completely absorbed in her teenage years to the point she's grown edgy, hasn't she?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ずい分話が違うじゃないか……
こいつのどこがとっても優しい人格者なんだ？
思春期丸出しで
尖りまくってるぞ？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Adolescence, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……思春期、
か。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: It's just, my father; which to Iroha would be her grandfather. When he was a kid, he worked as a bodyguard at Maristella-san's alchemy workshop, and she loved him like a younger brother.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや
私の父……
イロハにとってはおじいちゃんだけど。
その父が子どもの頃、
マリステラさんの錬金工房で
用心棒をしてて、
弟みたいにかわいがられてたんだって。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: When she was young, Maristella-san used to be an incredibly vicious delinquent girl. Apparently used the power of alchemy to do whatever she wanted. She would create tornadoes or even make monsters go on a rampage...
text_block_list.orig_text:
若い頃のマリステラさんは
とんでもない非行少女で、
錬金術の力を使って
やりたい放題だったらしいわ。
竜巻を起こしたり、
魔物を暴れさせたり……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: They said she was completely out of control--until one day, something changed, and she turned over a new leaf...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ある日を境に
心を入れ替えるまで、
本当に手が付けられなかったって……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...! I see...! ...Maristella-san didn't fail in her alchemy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！　
そうか……！
……マリステラさんは
錬金術に失敗なんかしてないんだ。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.orig_text: どゆこと？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: This isn't a side effect born from failure, it's something that Rui-chan herself often says...! You know, the thing you say when you fail at alchemy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは
失敗の副作用なんかじゃなくって、
ルイちゃんがよく言うやつだ……！
ほら、
錬金術に失敗した時に言うやつ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I NEVER fail in my alchemy! Well... I'm a genius, so sometimes I succeed too much and the resulting effects are greater than usual.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は錬金術で失敗なんてしないわ！
ま……
天才だから
成功しすぎて、
普段以上の効果が出ちゃうことはあるけど。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: That's known as failure.
text_block_list.orig_text: それ失敗ですわ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
それ。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Originally, it was supposed to be a forbidden elixir that would only rejuvenate the body, but she ended up creating something that also rejuvenated her intelligence, personality, and even memory--Because she's a genius, she overdid at what she was aiming to do...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なるほど。
本来は肉体だけが若返る秘薬のはずが、
知能や性格、
記憶までもが若返る薬を作ってしまった──
天才だから、
成功しすぎて。

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: *Sneeze*...! ...*slurp* That's strange. The effects of the raining elixir should only last for a few minutes, but it still hasn't stopped! It seems I'm such a genius that I've naturally overdid myself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いっ
くし……っ！　
……ずずっ。
おかしいわね、
雨を降らせる秘薬の効果は数分なのに
まだ止まないわ！
天才すぎて
成功しすぎちゃったみたいね！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: ...Seems we've hit the mark.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……絶対そうね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: In other words, not only is Maristella's body now 17 years old, but her mind and memories are also 17 years old.
text_block_list.orig_text:
つまり、
今のマリステラは
肉体だけじゃなく、
心も記憶も
完全に
17歳
って
わけなんだね。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, it makes sense that she doesn't remember anything. She'd also have no memories of ever having a grandchildren at that age.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら何も覚えていないのも頷けます。
そもそも
孫がいる記憶自体がないんですもの。

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text: Certainly, I've thought it was strange since we met her. The way Maristella talks... Those are all old fashioned words she's using.
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かにずっとおかしいと思っていたんだ。
マリステラのしゃべり方……
あれは
古の流行言葉。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that'd be considered outdated slang now... but I see. For Maristella, it's cutting-edge trendy lingo...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
今では
死語ってやつだけど……
そうか。
マリステラ氏にとっては、
最先端の
流行語なんだよ……！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: ...In other words, she’s not some wise and mellowed-out elder.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……つまりあれは。
年老いて丸くなった人格者なんかじゃない。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: She's young and arrogant! A wicked Great Alchemist...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
若く傲慢で、
悪逆非道な
大錬金術師よ……！

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Homun-Homun?! You've been fighting only against that busty girl for a while now!! Everyone else has been heading my way! I'm surrounded here!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ちょっとホムンホムン！？
さっきからそのボインちゃんとしか戦ってないじゃない！！
他全員こっちにきちゃってんだけど！？　
囲まれてるわ私！！

text_block_list.name: Homun-Homun
text_block_list.text: Well... I kind of want to help, but this gal's too strong!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや
行きたいのはやまやまなんだが、
こいつはちゃめちゃに強え！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: HAHAHAHAH! HERE, HERE~!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はははっ！
そらそら～～～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Maristella-san! Give up at once!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マリステラさん、
観念して！

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: Guh...!! Nununuu...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ……！！
ぬぬぬぅ
……っ！！

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: ...As if. Did you think I'd give up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なーんて、
言うと思ったかしら？

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAH!! Original Transmutation!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はああっ！！
『基創錬成』！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: What fast, accurate, and perfect alchemy...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんて速く正確で、
完璧な錬金術……！

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: Heheh, it's done! A Maristella's original... the "Fly-fly Away Elixir"!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふんっ、
完成！
『マリステラ特製・
適当にどこかに飛ばす薬』よ！！

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: Well then, have a good day... Buh-bye!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃごきげんよう！
バイビー！

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃああああ～～～っ！！！

text_block_list.name: Homun-Homun
text_block_list.text: ...Heh heh. What a marvelous display, Maristella... You've sent them all flying!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……へへ。
さすがマリステラだぜ……
全員飛んでっちまった！

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. What's with you? Were you left behind?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふん。
なにあなた。
取り残されちゃったの？

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: Aha, as if I know! Well, there's no need to worry about that. I'll make sure to send you flying too!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはっ、
知らないわ！
ま、
そんなこと気にする必要ないわよ。
あなたもちゃんと飛ばしてあげるから！！

text_block_list.name: Maristella
text_block_list.text: Then! Buh-bye!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃ、
バイビー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The elixir created by Maristella sent Alces Atelier and the Twilight Caravan flying somewhere followed by {0}...
text_block_list.orig_text:
マリステラの生み出した薬によって、
どこかに飛ばされてしまった
【アルケス錬金堂】と【トワイライトキャラバン】
……そして、
{0}。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ...What will happen to our heroes?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 果たして一行はどうなってしまうのか──
